design_rule: The basketball roster and compound-growth card each have a single job. The roster explains the inference; the calculation card explains the arithmetic. Neither becomes financial advice or a forecast.

clusters.purpose: Make the episode’s two-jobs inference memorable: ticker-count diversification can coexist with shared causes and automatic allocation that fails to buy independent defense.
must_not_imply: reserves or long-tail companies are worthless
the S&P 500 is a proven bubble

clusters.purpose: Distinguish broad-participation success from an individual’s stated wealth objective, quantify only the illustrative hurdle, then introduce separate upside and defense jobs without a recommendation.
clusters.asset_strategy: reframe from the roster to a deterministic return-hurdle calculation only when the starting value and target are spoken; prepare a new neutral two-basket mechanism for the next cue cluster.
